description.value: Nuba is a well-established Vancouver Lebanese restaurant group with four city locations; the Yaletown 'Canteen' on Davie Street occupies a striking space fitted with overlapping ogival arches and wooden screens that blend traditional Middle Eastern geometry with a modern urban aesthetic. Founded nearly 20 years ago, Nuba sources fresh, local, and organic ingredients daily and emphasizes scratch cooking, with a large share of the menu being vegan and halal-certified meats. The Davie Street location includes both indoor and outdoor seating, making it a solid meal stop in a busy, cyclist-friendly neighbourhood.
